skill_name: Recommend a good beginner yoga class
workflow: Yoga is a great form of exercise for those looking to relax and get fit. A good beginner yoga class should focus on the basics and help build a strong foundation. To get the most out of a beginner class, seek out an instructor who is patient, attentive and has experience teaching students at all levels.
